nodes.label: Quiz Backend Scope
nodes.rationale: The work covers the quiz backend and its technical exchange with the site, catalog, prices, stock, and cart. Advertising setup, paid traffic, and advertising analytics are outside scope.

nodes.label: Buyer-Selected Budget Input
nodes.rationale: The buyer selects a budget range and the quiz uses it when matching results. The cited ranges are examples and still require approval.

nodes.label: Local HTML Form with Telegram Submission
nodes.norm_label: local html form with telegram submission

nodes.label: Goal-Based Matching and Business Outcomes
nodes.rationale: The quiz should match a buyer's sports goal and relevant personal parameters to a suitable set. Expected outcomes are higher conversion and fewer product-selection consultations; exact goals, parameters, and metrics remain undecided.

nodes.label: Questionnaire for One Client
nodes.rationale: The questionnaire is for one client, who can identify another technical contact if needed. Its questions should not be addressed to the website team.

nodes.label: Buyer Inputs That Change Matching
nodes.rationale: This questionnaire item should collect only buyer data that changes product matching and the required value types. It should not ask the owner to write the complete customer-facing quiz.

nodes.label: Conditional Questions Based on Result Type
nodes.rationale: First determine whether the quiz returns ready-made sets, individual products, product groups, or new combinations. Questionnaire branches should depend on that choice so irrelevant questions are skipped.
nodes.norm_label: conditional questions based on result type

nodes.label: Basis and Coverage of Matching Rules
nodes.rationale: Useful rules need an explicit basis for mapping buyer answers to products and examples covering important cases in the first scenario. A question count alone does not establish completeness.
nodes.norm_label: basis and coverage of matching rules

nodes.label: Recommendations Limited to On-Site Products
nodes.rationale: The quiz may recommend only products already listed on the site. The questionnaire should focus on quiz logic and avoid asking for context that is already known.

nodes.label: Catalog Access and Matching Requirements
nodes.rationale: The questionnaire should establish which catalog data is needed, how to access it, how buyer answers map to products, and who approves the rules. The database platform, schema, API, and safe read-only access are unverified.

nodes.label: Recommendation May Contain One or More Products
nodes.norm_label: recommendation may contain one or more products

nodes.label: Approved Analysis and Tagging Policy for 206 Sets
nodes.rationale: Use the 2026-11-06 catalog snapshot as the baseline for prices, record price discrepancies, and mark unknowns explicitly. Do not infer buyer weight or exact distance, confuse product size with buyer weight, or present seller health claims as independently verified effects.
nodes.norm_label: approved analysis and tagging policy for 206 sets
